subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should the agent runtime accept treating oversized, symlinked, or otherwise non-regular workspace `IDENTITY.md` files as missing identity after this PR?
rationale: The implementation reduces unbounded workspace-file memory exposure, but the fallback behavior changes existing setups that relied on large or symlinked identity files.

options.title: Accept the hard cap
options.body: Merge the PR as written because `IDENTITY.md` is intended to be a small regular workspace file and the standalone proof now covers the oversized fallback path.

options.title: Require a diagnostic
options.body: Ask for a warning, doctor check, or visible runtime explanation so users can discover why identity values disappeared.

options.title: Preserve a compatibility path
options.body: Request a bounded read implementation that still supports a specific existing file shape, such as symlinked identity files, if maintainers consider that supported.

recommendation.title: Accept the hard cap
recommendation.body: Merge the PR as written because `IDENTITY.md` is intended to be a small regular workspace file and the standalone proof now covers the oversized fallback path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest merged history on the identity/avatar feature and recent ownership of the touched identity-file surface.
